questions.prompt: Can an informal norm override safety requirements?

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Maps roles, responsibilities, authority and dependencies while distinguishing status and informal norms.
scoring.transfer: Create a group-role and authority map for a fictional meeting. Include at least four roles, one informal influence, two dependencies and a possible conflict between common practice and actual authority.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
